title: SHIMA SEIKI APEXFiz Plugin
content: ## **New in CLO 2026.0** **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/56360391337625)** **Recommended Specification** **Overview of How Data is Mapped** **Naming in APEXFiz and CLO** **Exporting Data from APEXFiz** **Importing Data to CLO** **Updating Design** **** _This plugin automates the connection of complex knit material data between_[ _APEXFiz_](https://www.shimaseiki.com/product/design/software/) _and CLO, including PBR textures, material layers, and part-based mapping._ #### **Recommended Specification** * **CLO:** 2026.0 or later versions * **APEXFiz:** V-09C or later versions #### **Overview of How Data is Mapped** * **Part-to-Pattern Mapping:** Each **Part created in APEXFiz** is mapped to a **Pattern piece in CLO**. * **Exact Name Matching:** The mapping is triggered by an exact match of the 'Part Name'. * **Automated Material Assignment:** Once a match is found, the plugin applies all associated materials and PBR textures specifically to that matched part. #### **Naming in APEXFiz and CLO** 1. Once the knit design is finalized in **APEXFiz** , check each **Part Name**. 2. In **CLO** , the **Pattern Name** must match **APEXFiz's Part Name** exactly. _**📝 Note:**_ \- _Using single-byte alphanumeric characters (A-Z, 0-9) for naming._ \- _Avoid using double-byte characters (e.g., Kanji, Cyrillic) or special characters \ / : * ? " < > | for naming._ #### **Exporting Data from APEXFiz** 1. In **APEXFiz,** navigate to the **3D Mapping Editor** ▶ Click the **"▼" (arrow)** next to the **Save icon** ▶ Select **Export to CLO**. → Show a pop-up menu of Export to CLO. 2. Set the Colorway, Resolution, Name, and File Type for export. 3. Click **Default** to set the default export path. _Default Path: C:\Users\Public\Documents\CLO\External\ShimaSeiki_ _**📝 Note:** Default Path is required for automatically recognizing files and ensuring smoother data transactions. _ 4. Click **Execute.** → A main folder is created, containing individual sub-folders for each part. Folders follow the naming in '**Name_Colorway_PartName** '. → Each sub-folder contains U3M material data and PBR texture maps. ![1_ExportingDatafromAPEXFiz_gif.gif](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/56836676591129) #### **Importing Data to CLO** 1. In **CLO** , open a**** project file****(**ZPRJ**), garment file (**ZPAC**), or patterns (**DXF**). 2. Check if the**Pattern Name** in **CLO** matches the **Part Name** in **APEXFiz**. 3. Navigate to **Main Menu** ▶ **Plugins** ▶ **APEXFiz** ▶ Select **Import from APEXFiz**. → Load PBR textures → Map materials to each pattern automatically based on name matching. _**✨Tip:** _ _\- Use![Edit-Texture.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/56360623941657) _[_**Edit Texture**_](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002680348-Edit-Texture) _to scale or reposition textures directly on the patterns or the 3D garment._ _\- Access_[ _**Print Layout Mode**_](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013408108-Edit-Fabric-Print-Layout-Mode) _to align patterns precisely against the texture map._ ![2_ImportingDatatoCLO_gif.gif](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/56836695302425) #### **Updating Design** 1. In **APEXFiz** , modify the design. 2. Re-export by following Exporting Data from APEXFiz. 3. Re-import to CLO by following Importing Data to CLO.
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on integrating complex knit material data between APEXFiz and CLO 2026.0, detailing the processes for mapping, exporting, and importing data to streamline design updates.

title: Group Internal Lines and Shapes
content: ## **New in CLO 2025.0** Group with Transform Pattern Group with Edit Pattern Select or Edit Grouped Items with Transform Pattern Ungroup with Transform Pattern #### Group the selected internal lines and shapes. Group baselines and shapes is also suitable. #### #### **Group with Transform Pattern** 1. Select 2 or more internal lines or shapes. Right-click on them to show the context menu. 2. Select **Group** **▶ Group** to group the selected items. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48694578661401)** ## ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48694628210329) [![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/50833136272281)](https://youtu.be/dF0OgRxNnwg?si=aU-ZM7oCvjLxNXWg) • A shortcut key for grouping is available. **Function** | **Shortcut** ---|--- **Group** | Windows: Ctrl + G / Mac: Command + G **Ungroup** | Windows: Ctrl + Delete / Mac: Command + Delete; or Command + Fn + Backspace • When grouping or ungrouping internal lines or shapes on one side of a symmetric or half-symmetric pattern, both sides are impacted. • Group relationship is maintained for pattern copy & paste, symmetrical copy, cutting, and merging cases. #### #### **Group with Edit Pattern** 1. Select the whole group of internal lines and segment points. Right-click on them to show the context menu. 2. Select **Group** **▶ Group** to group the selected items. **📝****Note:** When selecting an incompleted line or point of Internal Line or Shape, the Group menu will not show. #### #### **Select or Edit Grouped Items** **with Transform Pattern** 1. Click on the grouped internal lines or shapes to select the whole group. 2. Click again on the individual internal lines or shapes to select individual lines or shapes. #### #### **Ungroup with Transform Pattern** 1. Select the grouped internal lines or shapes. Right-click on them to show the context menu. 2. Select **Group** **▶ Ungroup** to remove the group relationship of the selected items.
content_description: Discover the new grouping features in CLO 2025.0, enabling efficient organization and manipulation of internal lines and shapes for enhanced design workflow.

title: Bond: How to Add Interlining / Fusible / Reinforcement
content: * To express bonding, select a pattern or internal shape with the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005592407/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Transform.png) **Transform Pattern** tool. * In the Property Editor, tick on **Bond** under **Bond/Skive**. → The selected component is now being displayed in a semi-transparent orange-brown color. * Under **Physical Property** , find the following options: Preset **Fusible (Common):** Tricot Interfacing, 47gsm **Fusible (Lapel):** Wefted Interfacing, 30gsm **Fusible (Nonwoven):** Fiber Web (pellon brand), 40gsm **Fusible (Nonwoven_Small Parts):** Stronger Fiber Web, 32gsm **Reinforcement (Pocket Bone):** Fiber Web without Fuse, 38-42gsm **Reinforcement (Undercollar):** Hair Cloth (edited), 180gsm Detail By default, these are the same as the fabric's, but can be edited separately if desired. * Upon simulating, the bonded area is now being displayed more stiffly, as if an interlining has been fused onto it.
content_description: This web page provides guidance on using the Transform Pattern tool to apply bonding effects and customize physical properties for enhanced fabric simulations in clothing design.

title: Fixed Topology Grading
content: ## **New in 2026.1** **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/59645741288473)** **Set and Configure Fixed Topology Grading** **** _Fixed Topology optimizes how CLO handles garment meshes during grading by minimizing unnecessary remeshing when switching between sizes._ #### **Set and Configure Fixed Topology Grading** 1. Select Object Browser ▶ Grading tab ▶ Click the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/59646417874585) **Setting** button located on each Size Group. 2. Turn on or off **Fixed Topology.** 3. After turning on **Fixed Topology** , set **Auto or Custom Mesh Source** to define which size mesh structure dictates the master topology profile. 4. Click **OK** to apply changes. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/59646417875993) **📝****Note:** The system reverts to standard grading for the exceptional cases, which is expected behavior.
content_description: Discover how to optimize garment grading in CLO 2026.1 with the new Fixed Topology feature, minimizing remeshing when adjusting sizes.

title: Pose (POS/HPOS) Open/Save
content: **Objective** Use this function to load an Avatar's Pose or location information. A variety of Avatar Poses are provided in the Library window. **Location** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Open/ Save As ▶ **Pose/ Hand Pose (ver 7.1)** **Operation** **Open Pose** 1. Click the menu of the Location to open a Pose/Hand Pose. → Open Pose window appears. 2. Set the options and click the **OK** button. **Pose Only** | Applies the Pose Motion Data (Joint rotation) only, while maintaining the Avatar's Size. ---|--- **Pose & Joint Translation** | Applies the Avatar's Size, Pose, Motion Data (joint rotation) and Joint positions **Partial Pose (ver 7.1)** | Apply all pose files, or apply Hand Pose only. → If the pose is changed and the garments are put on, it is automatically simulated. **Save Pose** 1. Select the menu indicated. → The Save File window appears. → When there are more than two Avatars, select the appropriate one from the Save Pose window. 2. Designate the file name and the path and select the **Save** button. → The Pose(POS/HPOS) file is saved.
content_description: This web page provides instructions for loading, applying, and saving Avatar poses and location information using the Pose/Hand Pose function in the software.

title: 2D Pattern (AI/PDF) Import/Export
content: **List of Contents** Import Adobe (AI/PDF) Import (Add) Adobe (AI/PDF) Export Adobe (PDF) **Objective ** Import Adobe (AI/PDF) formatted patterns into CLO, and export patterns created in CLO as a PDF file. ** Location** **Import Adobe (AI/ PDF) ** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import ▶ **Adobe (AI/ PDF)** **Import (Add) Adobe (AI/ PDF) ** Main Menu ▶ Import (Add) ▶ **Adobe (AI/ PDF)** **Export Adobe (PDF) ** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Export ▶ **Adobe (PDF)** ** Operation** **Import Adobe (AI/ PDF)** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import ▶ **Adobe (AI/ PDF)** → The Open File window appears. 2. Select the desired file to be imported and click **OK**. → The Import Adobe (AI/ PDF) window appears. 3. Adjust the settings as needed and select **OK**. **※ Note: ****Import Adobe (AI/ PDF) Options** **** **** **Scale** | Select the unit used in AI. ---|--- **Rotation** | Rotate all patterns as importing them. **Option** **(Import as Baseline)** | All shapes encompassed within their outer shape (pattern) will be imported as baselines. **Option** **(Import as Internal Shapes)** | All shapes encompassed within their outer shape (pattern) will be imported as internal shapes (ver3.1.0). **Option** **(Import as Graphic)** | All shapes/images encompasses within their outer shape (pattern) will be imported as graphics (ver3.1.0). Open shapes with color information will be imported as graphics as well (ver3.1.0). **Import (Add) Adobe (AI/ PDF)** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Import (Add) ▶**Adobe (AI/ PDF)** → The Open File window appears. 2. As setting Import Adobe (AI/PDF) options, adjust Import (Add) Adobe (AI/PDF) options as needed. **Export Adobe (PDF)** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Export ▶ **Adobe (PDF)** → The Save File window appears. 2. Type in the file name and designate the path the file is exported to. → The Export PDF window appears. 3. Adjust Scale and Rotation, and then click **OK**. → The patterns will be exported as a PDF file. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This page provides a comprehensive guide for importing Adobe (AI/PDF) formatted patterns into CLO and exporting CLO-created patterns as PDF files.

title: Merge
content: **List of Contents** Pattern Outline Sewing Line **Objective** Merge two Patterns into a single Pattern. **Location** **Pattern Outline** Main Menu ▶ 2D ▶ Edit ▶ **Edit Pattern** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![Edit Pattern.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/53205990209817) **Edit Pattern** **Sewing Line** Main Menu ▶ 2D ▶ Sewing ▶ **Edit Sewing** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![Edit Sewing.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/53205952068505) **Edit Sewing** **Operation** **Pattern Outline** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D ▶ Edit ▶ **Edit Pattern** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![Edit Pattern.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/53205990209817) **Edit Pattern** 2. Select two Pattern outlines which two Patterns are to be merged accordingly. **※ Note:** When the Patterns are symmetrically linked, select the Pattern outline of the either Pattern. 3. title: Change Length
content: **Objective** Type in the segment length and edit Pattern. **Location** Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ **Edit Pattern** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001101227/2.png) **Edit Pattern** ** ****Operation** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location 2. Right-click on the segment to be adjusted to access the pop-up menu. Then, select **Change Length.** → The Change Length window appears. 3. Set each option and click the **OK **button. **Length** | Enter the length of the segment to change. ---|--- **Direction** | Set the direction to change the length. **Lock Curve Points** | If a line connected to the selected line is a curve, the curve point is moved according to the changed length. title: 3D File (FBX) Import/Export
content: **List of Contents** **Import FBX** **Export FBX** **** By Importing an FBX file, Geometry, Material, Joint, Camera, and Camera Animation information are also imported. **** #### **Import FBX** 1. Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import/Import (Add) ▶**FBX** → The Open File window appears. 2. Select the desired file and click **OK**. → The Import FBX window appears. 3. Select the settings and click **OK**. → The FBX file is imported based on the setting. Basic | **Load Type** | Open or import the FBX file. ---|---|--- **Object Type** | Import the FBX file as Avatar or Trim. **Scale** | Select the unit or enter the specific value. **Object** | **Camera** | Toggles whether the Camera data or Camera Animation data is imported. **Animation** | Toggles whether the Animation data is imported. **Cache** **Animation (MC)** | Toggles whether the Cache Animation data is imported. **Axis Conversion** [**![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/53142603909657)Watch Video**](https://youtu.be/WRkb4MR0dP0?si=gL8VgdcciiEKfWLn&t=1538) | Change the direction of each axis of the object. **Option** | **Move Garment to Start Position** | Jump to the position of the start frame of the motion where the garment was loaded and move it.. **📝****Note:** Among the avatar skinning types, Dual Quaternion and Eblend are not compatible with CLO. **** #### **Export FBX** 1. Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Export ▶**FBX** → The Save File window appears. 2. Designate the file saving path and file name, and then click**OK**. → The Export OBJ window appears. 3. Select the settings as needed and click **OK**. → The file is exported as a FBX file based on the setting. **** **Object** **** **** **** **** **** **** **** | **Select an Avatar** | Select the avatar to be exported. The selected avatar is saved with its rigging data. You can exclude it as desired. ---|---|--- **Single/Multiple** | Exports selected objects as Single or Multiple Objects. ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360100786234) **Unweld/** **Weld** | When exporting, the connected Vertex(Mesh's points) where seamlines are set in the pattern are combined into individual objects or a single point. ![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360102949453) **Weld selected Patterns in Workspace** | Weld the selected patterns connected by sewing lines. **Thin / Thick** | Sets whether to export geometry of the rendering thickness. **Unified UV Coordinates (PNG)** | Exports the texture information of all garment patterns to fit within the UV coordinate values between 0 and 1. Image Scale | Set image scales. Fill Texture Seams | This Function expands the range of the texture based on the border of the texture. **Include Internal Shapes** | The information of the Internal Line included in the garment is also exported. **Option** | **Animation** | When the FBX file is loaded, the animation information in the file is saved together. **Cache Animation (MC)** | Save the recorded garment animation as cache data together. **Basic** | **Scale** | Enter a number or select the desired unit from "Unit of file to be imported" and adjust the scale of the object. **Animation** | Entire Region | Save the recorded garment's animation entirely. Play Region | Only the garment animation in the play area is saved. **File Type** | Select whether to save as Binary / Ascii. * The file is stored in binary and cannot be opened by the user. * Ascii: The file is saved as text so the user can open and understand it. **Texture** | **Relative Texture Image File Path** | Save only the texture name without the texture image path, so if the saved FBX file and the texture image used in the file are in the same path, the texture image is automatically loaded. **Absolute Texture Image File Path** | Save the folder path where the texture image was located as the texture image path. If the path of the texture image is changed, the texture image cannot be loaded. **Embed Media (.zip)** | Export as a zip file along with the texture files used. **Diffuse Color Combined on Texture** | When a color is applied to the texture, it is saved as a combined color and texture. FBX files cannot contain all data, texture images and color values so select that option to export color information applied to textures as well. Animation | **Entire Region** | ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55505671959705) Exports the entire range where animation keys are set. **Play Region Only** | ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55505671959705) Exports only the animation within the specified playback range. **File** | **Save Colorways** | Export the garment with colorways Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide for importing and exporting FBX files, detailing the necessary steps and options for managing geometry, materials, animations, and camera settings effectively.

title: Run V-Ray Render
content: ### **Objective** V-Ray Render produces more vivid and sophisticated images with clear seamlines and puckerings. **Location ** Main Menu ▶ Render ▶ **Render ** Main Menu ▶ Display ▶ Window ▶ **Render** ** Operation** 1. Select the too/menu indicated in Location. → The Render window appears. 2. Click on the ![interactive_render.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115025949628) **Interactive Render** tool from the Render toolbar or click on the following direction,"Click here to start the Interactive Render," at the center of the Render window to start the real time render. → The 3D Garment and Avatar in the 3D window are rendered in real time, reflecting the [3D view](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000628267-%EB%B7%B0-%EC%A0%9C%EC%96%B4). → Any changes made to material properties are applied to the Render window in real-time when the Interactive Render is active. **📝****Note: • **When the **![Camera Lock On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33940373641753)Lock Camera** in the Render toolbar is activated, tthe render view remains fixed while controlling the view in the 3D window. (ver 2024.1) • At the bottom left of the render window, you can adjust the size of the interactive render screen. 3. To temporarily stop the render, select the ![stop_render.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115025910647) **Stop Render** tool from the Render toolbar. → The render stops temporarily. 4. To restart the render, please select the ![interactive_render.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115025949628) **Interactive Render** tool again. Or, to finish the render and extract the rendered image, click on the ![final_render.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115025910747) **Final Render (Image/ Video)** tool. → The final render image is saved according to the [render properties](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115014899148)**,[ light properties](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115014899168), **and **[image/ video properties](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115014785207)**.
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide on using V-Ray Render to create high-quality, interactive 3D garment and avatar images in real-time, highlighting key tools and features for enhanced rendering.
